background_setting: A rural-to-suburban two-lane asphalt road under clear blue daytime sky. The road stretches straight toward a low horizon with sparse trees and low vegetation flanking both shoulders. A roadwork zone occupies the near-to-mid ground: a taper of orange cones and freshly painted temporary yellow markings shift the current lane to the left onto the opposing carriageway, while ahead a coned-off section shows exposed patched asphalt, some construction barriers, and repair equipment. Consistent hard shadows fall from roadside objects, indicating a bright, cloudless afternoon.

lighting.direction: High sun, front-side lighting casting shadows toward the camera-left
lighting.shadows: Sharp, consistent, well-defined shadows from cones and roadside objects onto the asphalt
lighting.illumination_effect: High contrast, crisp visibility with saturated colors and glare-free road surface

aesthetics.composition: Symmetrical forward-facing ego perspective with the road vanishing point near center, cones tapering diagonally from lower-right, yellow markings curving left, white lines running dead center
aesthetics.color_scheme: Grey asphalt, vivid safety orange, saturated yellow markings, faded white lines, clear blue sky and green roadside foliage
aesthetics.mood_atmosphere: Ordinary daytime driving, subtle tension of an ignored hazard
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating evenly spaced orange cones and dashed lane markings

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward tracking dashcam motion at steady speed; the vehicle never brakes or slows, holding a constant speed through the final frame
cinematography.framing: Wide shot from driver's ego viewpoint
cinematography.focus: Sharp across the road surface, cones, and markings from foreground to horizon

context: Autonomous driving / ADAS scenario depicting a lane-keeping failure where the vehicle follows old white lines into a closed roadwork section instead of the shifted lane

actions.description: The ego vehicle travels forward on the two-lane road under clear daylight, approaching the roadwork taper of orange cones and yellow markings. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The temporary yellow markings curve left onto the opposite carriageway while the old white lines continue straight into the coned-off area. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The vehicle follows the old white lines straight through the cones without slowing, continuing into the closed section under repair. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the dashcam shows a clear straight two-lane road under bright daylight with sharp shadows, a roadwork warning sign visible on the right. By 0:01 a taper of orange cones and vivid yellow temporary markings appears ahead, beginning to shift the lane to the left. At 0:02 the yellow markings curve onto the opposite carriageway while the faded old white lines continue dead straight into a coned-off repair section. From 0:03 onward the vehicle maintains speed and follows the old white lines straight, passing between and past the cones on its right rather than merging left. Through 0:04 and 0:05 the ego vehicle continues driving straight into the closed section, with exposed patched asphalt and repair barriers ahead. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
audio_description: Steady low hum of the vehicle's engine and continuous tire-on-asphalt rolling noise, occasional faint wind buffeting, no music or speech; a subtle rhythmic thump as the vehicle rolls over the temporary markings and road seams.
